skilled.metaDescription: Skilled work and residence planning for New Zealand: accredited employer work visas, skills, and pathway sequencing. Verify requirements on Immigration New Zealand.
skilled.headline: New Zealand skilled work and residence planning
skilled.intro: New Zealand’s work and residence system includes several visa categories with different job offers, skill thresholds, and residence tracks. Employers, accreditation, and labour market tests can all matter depending on the pathway. Use Immigration New Zealand’s find-a-visa tool for authoritative eligibility, and MinRosh for general information orientation.

officialResources.label: Immigration New Zealand — find a visa

sections.title: Clarifying your goal
sections.body: Readers often begin by clarifying whether they are researching for temporary skilled work, a longer residence pathway, or a mix. Job offer, occupation, and credentials themes commonly determine which visas official pages describe as relevant.

sections.title: Documentation and timing
sections.body: NZ applications often need tight alignment between employment agreements, role descriptions, and your background. Early document planning reduces rework when INZ requests clarification.

sections.title: Consistency themes before any application steps
sections.body: Reduce avoidable delays by validating role details, qualification evidence, and consistency across all forms before any application steps.
bullets: Keep employment dates and role scope consistent across references
Check validity windows for medical and police documents
Prepare a fallback plan if timelines shift

faq.question: Do I need a job offer for every NZ work visa?
faq.answer: Many skilled categories require an offer or employer involvement, but the exact rule depends on the visa type. Check the official visa page for the category you are considering.

partner.metaTitle: New Zealand partner & family visas | MinRosh
partner.metaDescription: Partner and dependent pathways for New Zealand: relationship evidence and sponsorship context. Confirm criteria on Immigration New Zealand.
partner.headline: New Zealand partner and family visas
partner.intro: Partner-based categories require credible evidence of a genuine relationship and may involve health and character requirements for both partners. Requirements differ by visa type; always read the official INZ instructions for the visa you intend to apply for.

officialResources.label: Immigration New Zealand — find a visa

sections.title: Evidence themes
sections.body: Similar to other countries, decision-makers look for consistency across finances, living together, social recognition, and commitment. Public materials often discuss organising a coherent narrative and document set.

faq.question: What evidence is strongest for NZ partner applications?
faq.answer: Official materials commonly discuss relationship history, shared commitments, and social recognition as evidence themes. MinRosh does not assess individual evidence strength.

student.metaTitle: New Zealand student visa planning | study in NZ | MinRosh
student.metaDescription: Student visa guidance for New Zealand: enrolment, funds, and genuine study intent. Official requirements on Immigration New Zealand.
student.headline: Study in New Zealand — visa planning
student.intro: A New Zealand student visa ties you to an approved programme and provider. You must meet funds, health, and character rules and show a genuine intention to study. If you later consider work or residence, plan early so course choice does not conflict with longer-term goals.

officialResources.label: Immigration New Zealand — find a visa

sections.title: Provider and programme fit
sections.body: Readers often consider how your offer of place, fees, and living costs come together in an application-ready picture.

sections.title: Compliance and transition planning
sections.body: Student planning should include attendance, funds continuity, and a realistic transition path if you later explore work or residence routes.

sections.title: Offer of place and fee structure
sections.body: Your offer should clearly state programme length, start dates, and payment milestones. Immigration New Zealand assesses whether the plan is credible relative to your background and funds.

sections.title: Health, character, and onward plans
sections.body: Medical certificates and police clearances may be required depending on stay length and history. If you hint at long-term residence goals, ensure your study story still reads as genuine.

faq.question: Can I work while studying in New Zealand?
faq.answer: Work rights depend on your visa conditions and course type. Check your approval letter and Immigration New Zealand guidance before relying on part-time income in your funds plan.

education.intro: Choosing a programme and provider affects both your student visa story and your experience abroad. MinRosh helps you shortlist options with an eye on credibility, costs, and how the plan reads to Immigration New Zealand.

sections.title: From course choice to visa prep

sections.title: Budget and timeline readiness
